0022600185.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, on a six-game losing streak, 0-2 at home) host the Los Angeles Lakers (5-2, first in the Pacific, on a one-game winning streak). Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Kings lost 1-3 to the Lakers in 2025-26, including a 128-104 defeat in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026.
